subject: Superintendent Finalist Scenario Interviews
overview: The School Committee met as a committee of the whole to conduct scenario-based interviews with the two finalists for superintendent of schools, Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent and Thomas Martellone. No votes were taken, with deliberations and a final selection scheduled for the following meeting.

items.title: Superintendent Finalist Interview: Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent
items.summary: Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent presented proposals to resolve middle school enrollment disparities through STEAM programming and community outreach, followed by responses to hypothetical scenarios involving an emergency school evacuation and unexpected mid-year budget deficits.

items.title: Superintendent Finalist Interview: Thomas Martellone
items.summary: Thomas Martellone recommended implementing a geocoded placement model and buffer zones to balance middle school enrollment and demographics, and answered scenario questions regarding emergency facility shutdowns and mid-year budget cuts.
